summary: UNODC reports Afghanistan is the world's top opium producer, responsible for 87% of illicit output since the 2001 invasion. The 2004 UNODC report shows a 64% rise in production area and 22% increase in export value, US$2.8bn. Antonio Maria Costa said law enforcement could control opium, while Doug Wankel said the industry finances terrorism, warlordism and threatens Afghan and US security.
